name: Kanzaki Yamato
source:
Kanzaki is member of a criminal organization with an office near sótano. 

He’s an underling who’s caught Tojo’s eye and acts as his driver. He a rude and aggressive man, who won’t hesitate to use violence. Although he looks quick to start a fight, but he’s actually pretty calm, but on a fundamental level, he doesn’t think before he acts.

He went to school with Hiroyuki. They don’t seem quite close enough to be considered friends, though.

[From [url=http://mangagamerstaff.tumblr.com/post/111870262824/huh-what-the-fuck-you-crazy-or]MangaGamer[/url]]
